title: AI was everywhere at gaming’s big developer conference — except the games | The Verge
summary: Indie developers at the GDC Festival expressed strong opposition to using AI in their game development, citing the importance of the human element and uniqueness in their creations. Despite the potential benefits of generative AI for tasks like debugging and idea generation, there was a clear preference for maintaining a handmade, human touch in their games.
sentiment_reason: The sentiment is negative due to the expressed fear that AI could detract from the human element and uniqueness that indie developers strive to preserve in their games.
